notes: Search the web without opening the app: say “Hey Pilot, search for…”, “look up…”, “what's the weather?” or “what's the news?” from any app, even with the phone locked. The answer is spoken and shown in a notification with an Open results button (the browser opens only if you tap it or say “open that”). Say “tell me more” for more. No network or a slow search is told to you out loud, and your music only ducks.
